svg.text: RANGMANCH CHARACTER BIBLE: BADA KUNWAR AMAR (CHAR_001)
Culture: Malwai (Madhya Pradesh) | Role: Jyestha Putra / Elder Son

foreignObject.div:
Ground Truth Visual Prompt:
Full-body documentary portrait of Bada Kunwar Amar, age 32, elder son carrying family prestige. Costume: Dhoti-kurta, white cotton bandi, red safa/pagdi with silver pin. Setting: Malwa plateau, rural courtyard haveli. Natural soft morning light, dignified, solemn expression.
